maya: Heads-up: we're bundling a PLG experiment for a product push next month. Plan = 50 starter credits + a 5-template prompt pack + a short onboarding nudge series. Need: copy, routing, A/B matrix, dashboard. Goal: +20% users who run >=1 useful query within 48h.

zara: Quick flags: 1) split traffic (credit vs no-credit) for 72h, 2) surface 'try template' deep-link on landing page, 3) one-slide benchmark for socials.

leo: Routing: tag installs as `prompt_pack_installed` and set trait `marketing_source` from ?src param. If `prompt_pack_installed` within 24h -> set cohort = high_intent. I'll add webhook to CRM.

olivia: Metrics I'll track: activation_48h, retention_7d, cost_per_activated_user, webinar_signups. Standardize events: credit_redeemed, prompt_pack_installed, first_response_time.

sam: Copy ideas below - keeping 2 variants. Variant A (dev-first): "Ship faster: 50 starter credits + prompt pack to get your first useful response in minutes. Demo + benchmarks." Variant B (outcome-first): "Save developer hours: try a prompt pack + credits and see latency + cost that fit production."

maya: Experiment matrix: credit(50/0) x nudge_timing(immediate/6h) x landing_cta(preload/manual). Measure activation_48h. Owners: zara(copy + landing), leo(routing + webhooks), olivia(dash), sam(webinar assets). Prep freeze 48h before go-live.

ops-bot: Calendar event created by sam "Product Push: Prompt Pack Demo" at 1767779900. RSVP.

zara: I'll add the deep-link param: ?src=push_social and a fallback guided import. Also adding UTM for analytics.

leo: SDR playbook stub: if high_intent && usage > 150 tokens && no team invite in 72h -> SDR outreach. Will commit doc by Tue.

olivia: Dashboard draft ETA Thu EOD with cohort comparison (credit vs no-credit).

maya: Can eng/devex confirm a single-click import endpoint? @eng-devex please advise. If not possible, we still run with guided import.

sam: I'll prep a 60s benchmark clip + one-pager for sales. Also drafting 3 short social posts.

maya: Nice. Quick checklist before EOD: confirm deep-link feasibility, finalize copy, instrument events, dashboard skeleton. I'll collect final assets in the launch folder.

zara: uploading copy versions and post images by tomorrow AM.

leo: webhook + tag pushed to staging by Tue.

maya: thanks all
